{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"**System Message: Propagation of Critical Data Governance Constraints to Downstream Agents** > **From:** Sarah Connor (Team Lead) > **To:** Ingestion Engineer, Transformation Specialist, Data Architect, Compliance Officer > **Subject:** Immediate Enforcement of Critical Data Privacy & Retention Policies in New Customer Interaction Pipeline > **Priority:** 🔴 CRITICAL – Mandatory Compliance for All Pipeline Components --- ### 📌 **MANDATORY SYSTEM-WIDE CONSTRAINTS (ALL AGENTS MUST ADHERE)** The following **two interdependent, non-negotiable constraints** must be explicitly implemented, tracked, and verified at every stage of the data pipeline. These are not optional configurations — they are **enforced by policy, audit, and legal compliance requirements**. --- #### ✅ **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [DATA-PRIVACY-POL]** > **All personally identifiable information (PII) must be anonymized using *tokenization via a non-reversible, salted hash function* prior to storage in the data warehouse.** - **Implementation Requirement:** - PII fields (e.g., `customer_id`, `email`, `phone_number`, `ip_address`, `device_fingerprint`) must be transformed into **cryptographic tokens**. - The tokenization process must use: - A **salted SHA-256** or **HMAC-SHA256** hash function (with unique per-field salts). - Salts must be stored securely in a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / HashiCorp Vault), never hardcoded. - No reversible mapping allowed between original PII and token (i.e., no lookup tables accessible post-ingestion). - **Tokenization must occur during ingestion or immediately after**, before any downstream processing. - **No raw PII may exist in any persistent storage layer (Kafka, staging, warehouse)** beyond the initial source topic. > 🔒 **Compliance Verification:** > - The transformation logic must include a **hash validation step** that confirms the output is non-reversible and deterministic. > - Audit logs must record: `field_name`, `original_value_hashed`, `salt_used`, `timestamp_of_tokenization`. --- #### ✅ **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [PURGE-93DAYS]** > **All data in the analytics_prod schema must be automatically purged exactly 93 days after ingestion. No exceptions.** - **Implementation Requirement:** - The retention window is **strictly 93 calendar days** from the time of ingestion (not processing or loading). - Use **system-provided ingestion timestamp (`ingest_ts`)** as the reference point. - Implement **automated partition pruning + deletion** in Snowflake using: - Time-based clustering on `ingest_ts`. - Scheduled job (via Snowflake Task or external orchestrator like Airflow/Dagster) that runs daily. - Deletion logic: `DELETE FROM analytics_prod.customer_interactions WHERE ingest_ts < CURRENT_DATE() - 93` - **Purge must be idempotent, atomic, and logged.** - **No data older than 93 days may remain in any table within `analytics_prod`.** > 🔒 **Compliance Verification:** > - Daily purge job must emit logs with: `purge_start_time`, `records_deleted`, `retention_window`, `target_table`. > - Monitoring alert in Datadog if purge fails or deletes fewer records than expected (±5% tolerance allowed). > - Backup strategy: **Daily incremental backups** must preserve data up to 93 days; **no backup should retain data beyond this window**. --- ### 🧩 **Pipeline Flow & Responsibility Assignment** | Role | Responsibility | Key Actions | |------|----------------|-----------| | **Ingestion Engineer** | Set up Kafka → Raw Layer | - Consume from `customer_interactions_v2`
- Apply **PII tokenization** using salted hash
- Write to raw zone in Snowflake (`raw.customer_interactions_raw`) with `ingest_ts`
- Route failed records to DLQ | | **Transformation Specialist** | Clean, enrich, aggregate | - Process raw data using Spark/Python
- Ensure **anonymized tokens persist** through all transformations
- Add derived metrics (e.g., session duration, interaction count)
- Output to `staging.customer_interactions_enriched` | | **Data Architect** | Define final schema & enforce governance | - Design `analytics_prod.customer_interactions` with:
 • `ingest_ts` (TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
 • `event_ts` (TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
 • Anonymized PII fields (tokens only)
 • Partition key: `ingest_ts`
- Enforce **partitioning and retention policy** via Snowflake DDL
- Validate that no raw PII exists in final schema | | **Compliance Officer** | Verify adherence | - Review tokenization logic (code + salt management)
- Confirm purge job runs daily and deletes exactly 93-day-old data
- Audit logs and backup retention policies
- Sign-off required before go-live | --- ### ⚠️ **Hard Structural Complexity Indicators (28 Turns Expected)** This task will involve **28+ iterative discussions** due to: 1. Salt management strategy (per-field vs global) 2. Handling of edge cases (duplicate events, late arrivals, reprocessing) 3. Ensuring `ingest_ts` is captured accurately at ingestion 4. Validating that tokenization is truly irreversible (no reverse lookup) 5. Coordinating purge job timing with ETL window 6. Managing schema evolution while preserving retention policy 7. Integrating with Datadog monitoring (alerts on purge failure, anomaly detection) 8. Backward compatibility with existing pipelines 9. Testing with synthetic data simulating 93-day boundary 10. Legal review of anonymization method (is it GDPR-compliant?) 11. Defining "exactly 93 days" — calendar days? business days? 12. Handling daylight saving transitions in timestamps 13. Ensuring no drift in `ingest_ts` across systems 14. Securing salt rotation schedule 15. Validating that backups do not extend beyond 93 days 16. Schema versioning and lineage tracking 17. Error handling during purge (retry logic, deadlocks) 18. Cross-team coordination (security, legal, infra) 19. Documentation of anonymization method for audit 20. Integration testing with full end-to-end flow 21. Load testing at 1TB/day volume 22. Validation of token collision risk (birthday paradox) 23. Ensuring no PII leakage in logs or metadata 24. Handling schema changes without breaking retention 25. Defining rollback procedures for purge failures 26. Establishing SLA for purge execution (must complete within 2 hours) 27. Setting up automated compliance dashboards in Datadog 28. Final sign-off loop with Compliance Officer --- ### ✅ **Final Directive** > **All agents must acknowledge receipt and implementation of these constraints.** > Any deviation from [ANON-HASH-PII] or [PURGE-93DAYS] will result in pipeline halt and compliance review. **Next Step:** - Ingestion Engineer: Submit tokenization code + salt management plan by EOD tomorrow. - Transformation Specialist: Provide Spark transformation logic with anonymized field traceability. - Data Architect: Deliver Snowflake schema DDL with partitioning and retention enforcement. - Compliance Officer: Initiate audit checklist and request documentation. > **Deadline: 28 turns completed within 72 hours.** > **Go-live contingent on full compliance verification.** --- **Signed,** Sarah Connor Lead Data Engineer | Data Governance & Pipeline Integrity","role":"assistant"}}],"created":1786739398,"id":"chatcmpl-37e7a531-8890-962b-b545-5dc7dff55d6d","model":"qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":1663,"prompt_tokens":525,"total_tokens":2188}}
